decisions.decision: T-251 is done, so build on a branch from current main, not tantra-walkthroughs. Re-find each AUDIT.md finding by its code, since the line numbers are stale. (1) X015: the start-calendar-ws gate calls GET /accounts?search=<cal_ws_email> for every sending user and passes only when each one is CONNECTED. (2) X014/N009: look up Tantra's API docs or OpenAPI spec for service-account upload, account verify and eventDetails reminders. Use any endpoint that exists. If one is missing, the card keeps that step as a manual step and the gate still checks it. Write down which endpoints exist. (3) N011/N012: ev_length becomes a number in minutes, and end = new Date(start + minutes). (4) N018: send variants A and B to Tantra. (5) N015: fieldProblem rejects cal_title containing $, % or 'free'. (6) N028: card steps cover every sending user. Prove it with simulator probes. Never commit key JSON. Merge, push, then mark the ids fixed with the commit SHA.
decisions.why: T-251 is done, so the merge-order condition is met. The google-and-reminder-model rule (2026-10-07) sets one service account per Workspace user. The 2026-10-08 log confirms the Tantra connect flow. Tantra is our own product, so checking its docs is our job, not Adi's.
